title: Sandia history lists Kissinger as a seminar expert at Kirtland

tellings.quote: As part of his work, Carter organized interdisciplinary seminars featuring noted international experts and specialists, one of them, Henry Kissinger.

plain: Henry Kissinger appears in a redacted history of Sandia Laboratories, a nuclear weapons lab at Kirtland Air Force Base in New Mexico, as one of the experts at seminars around 1961, Jesse Michels points out. He reads from it himself: a man named Don Carter 'organized interdisciplinary seminars featuring noted international experts and specialists, one of them, Henry Kissinger.' Michels raises it in an episode asking whether Kissinger oversaw a programme to recover crashed UFOs; the passage places Kissinger at the base but says nothing about what the seminars covered.
